name: Original Nirnroot first pickup with position-driven ordinary approach under ASan/UBSan

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local t=-3;local path=nil;local step=2;local attempts=0;local aim=nil
local goal=util.vector3(53306.796875,91007.9765625,82.9418)
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Nirnroot approach')
 local count=types.Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x4e940))
 print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot stock='..count)
 if count>0 then print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot ingredient received');return end
 local finish=goal-self.position;local distance=math.sqrt(finish.x*finish.x+finish.y*finish.y)
 local reached=distance<65 and math.abs(finish.z)<250
 if reached then print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot arrived') end
 if (camera.getPosition()-goal):length()<160 then print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot within reach') end
 local target
 if reached then
 local plant=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6f184));assert(plant and plant:isValid(),'Original Nirnroot not present')
 local box=plant:getBoundingBox()
 if not aim or nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),aim,{{ignore=self}}).hitObject~=plant then
  aim=nil
  for _,z in ipairs({{.6,.3,0,-.3}}) do
   for _,x in ipairs({{0,.35,-.35,.7,-.7}}) do
    for _,y in ipairs({{0,.35,-.35,.7,-.7}}) do
     local point=box.center+util.vector3(x*box.halfSize.x,y*box.halfSize.y,z*box.halfSize.z)
     local v=point-camera.getPosition();local required=-math.atan2(v.z,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y))
     if math.abs(required)<1.4 and nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),point,{{ignore=self}}).hitObject==plant then aim=point;break end
    end
    if aim then break end
   end
   if aim then break end
  end
 end
 target=aim or box.center
 elseif distance<250 then target=goal
 else
 if not path then
 local status,p=nearby.findPath(self.position,goal,{{agentBounds=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),destinationTolerance=70}})
 print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot path status='..tostring(status)..' count='..#p)
 if #p<2 then return end;path=p;step=2;attempts=attempts+1;assert(attempts<20,'Nirnroot path repeatedly partial')
 for i,v in ipairs(path) do print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot path point '..i..' '..tostring(v)) end
 end
 while step<=#path do local v=path[step]-self.position;if math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)<60 and math.abs(v.z)<110 then step=step+1 else break end end
 if step>#path then path=nil;return end
 target=path[step]
 end
 local v=target-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y);local pitch=-camera.getPitch()
 if reached then local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target);yaw=math.atan2(p.x,-p.z);pitch=-math.atan2(p.y,math.sqrt(p.x*p.x+p.z*p.z))
 local origin=camera.getPosition();local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5))*2000,{{ignore=self}})
 local plant=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6f184))
 if ray.hitObject==plant and math.abs(yaw)<.02 and math.abs(pitch)<.02 then print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot plant facing') end
 end
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue Nirnroot aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.06 then print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot path facing') end
 print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot sample step='..step..' pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' distance='..distance)
end}}}}
